crossRefs.note: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found…
for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,
I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.

translations.web: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
translations.bsb: Then every island fled, and no mountain could be found.
translations.kjv: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
translations.asv: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
